product_metadata.title: Smith’s 50005 Edge Pro Compact Electric Knife Sharpener - Yellow & Grey - Straight Edge 2 Stage Sharpener - Electric & Manual Sharpening - Blade Guide - Outdoor & Kitchen - Pocket & Filet Knives
features: ELECTRIC SHARPENER – Smith’s Edge Pro Compact Electric Knife Sharpener has electric sharpening wheels made from a bonded synthetic abrasive that sharpens one side of the blade at a time. The blade guides provide precise sharpening straight-edge blades.

MANUAL SHARPENER –The manual sharpening slot is composed of crossed ceramic rods for cleaning up rough edges, maintaining sharp knives, and putting a final finished edge on your blade. We recommend using the ceramic sharpening slot for final edge honing.

NON-DAMAGING – The material used on the electric wheels guarantees longer wheel life, uniform cutting & minimum heat build-up, so it won’t damage or de-temper your blade. This sharpener is handy for hunters & fishermen who need quick precise sharpening.

GUARANTEED RESULTS – The electric sharpening slots feature blade guides that hold the knife at the correct sharpening angle & the fine-crossed ceramic rods create a preset sharpening angle that provides guaranteed results.

NON-SLIP BASE – The 120-volt electric sharpener features a soft-grip rubber handle and non-slip rubber feet for added comfort, stability, and safety. From kitchen knives to pocket & fillet knives, this sharpener is quick, precise, and reliable!
